conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed" AND resource.labels.job_name = "__JOB_NAME__"

documentation.content: The Cloud Run Job `__JOB_NAME__` had a FAILED execution. This job is shared by several triggers (nightly `embrapa ingest all`, and monthly `comtrade` / `ibge-pam` / `ibge-ppm` / `reconcile` overrides) — check `containerOverrides.args` on the execution to see which one ran. Since the CLI already exits 0 (no alert) when every failure is a marked transient upstream condition that self-heals on the next scheduled/resumed run (rate limits, timeouts — see `SourceTransientError` in the codebase), a `result=failed` here means at least one source failed for a reason that is NOT expected-transient — a real bug, permission/schema error, or a genuine data problem, and it needs a human. Investigate: `gcloud run jobs executions list --job __JOB_NAME__ --region <INGEST_JOB_REGION>` then `... executions describe <execution>`, or read the execution's logs for lines tagged `(unexpected — investigate)` vs `(transient)`. The pipeline also emits structured events consumable by `embrapa monitor`.
